purpose: Turn each portfolio project into a durable local planning/integration brain so generic /wc capacity disperses across projects and produces visible product work without a privileged global Guide.
laws: Each project brain has a stable STATE.json with monotonic revision.
A project-guide candidate fingerprints project_id + exact STATE revision + grounded project evidence, so finishing a cycle and incrementing revision opens a new cycle without duplicating the old one.
Project guides may run in parallel even though they share GUIDE_PLANNER role.

A project guide must consume local returns, maintain 2-5 grounded executable jobs, update its STATE by CAS, and execute or verify at least one local job when possible; planning-only closure is not success.
Generic /wc batches shard across role_ready candidates; no human project routing is required.
Infrastructure/control-plane work is secondary while product projects have frontier gaps unless a measured critical regression blocks execution.
Visible product changes should update associated page/news state when a registered surface exists.
No project guide may promote Current/Human Accepted/Served without authority.
A productive /wc should chain multiple durable units in the same chat instead of closing after the first RETURN.
Target 3 productive units per useful chat, soft-cap 2 consecutive units in the same project, then diversify unless the current project is the only grounded work.
BOUNDARY/NO_ACTION/telemetry-only outcomes do not count as productive units.
done_contract: frontier contains at least frontier_min_per_project grounded jobs or exact evidence explains why not
at least one local executable/verification job attempted when available
receipt references state revision before/after and changed/created work
worker_chain_stop_conditions: no compatible claimable work after bounded allocator attempts
